# Workflow Automation Builder

Allow users to define automated workflows that chain multiple tasks together. Support conditional logic (if tests fail, run fix task), scheduled execution, and event triggers (new issue created, PR opened).

## Rationale
Addresses user goal of automating the entire build cycle. Enables complex multi-step automations without manual intervention. Differentiates from competitors that can only handle single tasks.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to automate our release process so that I can run it with one click
- As a team lead, I want automatic bug fix attempts for new issues so that simple bugs get resolved quickly

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Visual workflow builder with drag-and-drop task arrangement
- [ ] Conditional logic supported (if/then/else based on outcomes)
- [ ] Workflows can be triggered manually, scheduled, or by events
- [ ] Workflow execution history is logged
- [ ] Pre-built workflow templates for common patterns (CI/CD, review, release)
